ctx.x: was Newmore(?) Moore, and everyone called him Pee Wee -- Pee Wee Moore. He was a baritone saxophone player who later played with the Dizzy Gillespie Band. He called me and said that he was working with Louis Jordan's band. Well, up until that period, I had always known Louis Jordan to have a quintet that he called The Tympany Five, and I was wondering, because he never used a baritone saxophone player. So I said, "What's happening?" "Well, Louis has a big band. It had something like 14 pieces, and the pianist had…

Right now I don't remember exactly where they were playing that night. But I went up and talked to Louis Jordan, and he said, "You can make tonight -- we don't have a pianist. And we'll talk about it afterwards." So I went up and I made that night, which was a Saturday night. After the date that night, Louis paid me off, and I asked him what did he think. He says, "Well, I've got to go to New York over the weekend, and I'll be back Monday, and I'll tell you what I think."
